entry.en: Your passport must expire at least 6 months after arrival and have at least 2 blank pages.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe vencer al menos 6 meses después de la llegada y tener al menos 2 páginas en blanco.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and at least 2 blank pages.

entry.en: You get a 30-day entry stamp on arrival, and without a stamp you may be fined.
entry.es: Recibes un sello de entrada de 30 días al llegar, y sin sello podrías recibir una multa.
entry.quote: You will get a 30-day visit entry stamp in your passport when you arrive. Make sure the border control officer puts a stamp in your passport otherwise you may get a fine.

entry.en: Travellers aged 20 and under going alone or with one parent need a notarised letter in Spanish from the non-travelling parents or guardians.
entry.es: Los menores de 21 que viajen solos o con un solo progenitor necesitan una carta notariada en español de los padres o tutores que no viajan.
entry.quote: people aged 20 and under travelling alone or with only one parent or legal guardian must have a notarised letter in Spanish from the parents or guardians not travelling with them.

entry.en: International departures carry an airport tax of USD40 to USD55, normally included in the ticket price.
entry.es: Los vuelos internacionales llevan una tasa de salida de 40 a 55 USD, normalmente incluida en el billete.
entry.quote: There is an airport departure tax for international flights ranging from USD40 - USD55 (or the same amount in Honduran lempiras) depending on the airport.

entry.en: Immigration at a land border may charge a fee of 3 US dollars in cash, and you should keep the receipt.
entry.es: En una frontera terrestre migración puede cobrar 3 dólares en efectivo; conserva el recibo.
entry.quote: When you arrive at a land border, the immigration authorities may charge you a fee of 3 US dollars (in cash).

entry.en: You must complete the Government of Honduras' customs declaration form before entering or leaving the country.
entry.es: Debes completar el formulario de declaración aduanera del Gobierno de Honduras antes de entrar o salir del país.
entry.quote: You must complete the Government of Honduras’ customs declaration form prior to entering or leaving the country.

safety.en: Honduras has one of the highest violent crime rates in Latin America.
safety.es: Honduras tiene una de las tasas de crimen violento más altas de América Latina.
safety.quote: Honduras has one of the highest violent crime rates in Latin America.

safety.en: Authorities can set up roadblocks anywhere at short notice, causing significant travel disruptions.
safety.es: Las autoridades pueden instalar bloqueos en cualquier lugar con poco aviso, lo que causa importantes interrupciones.
safety.quote: the authorities can set up roadblocks anywhere at short notice and these cause significant travel disruptions.

safety.en: It is illegal for foreigners to take part in political activities, and protesters may be detained and deported.
safety.es: Es ilegal que los extranjeros participen en actividades políticas, y quienes protesten pueden ser detenidos y deportados.
safety.quote: It is illegal for foreigners to participate in political activities. If you take part in protests, you may be detained and deported.

safety.en: There have been violent attacks on people in cars and buses.
safety.es: Ha habido ataques violentos contra personas en autos y autobuses.
safety.quote: There have been violent attacks on people in cars and buses.

safety.en: Hurricane season normally runs from May to November, and landslides and flooding can affect roads.
safety.es: La temporada de huracanes normalmente va de mayo a noviembre y los deslizamientos e inundaciones pueden afectar las carreteras.
safety.quote: The hurricane season in Honduras normally runs from May to November. Landslides and flooding can affect roads throughout the country.

safety.en: Unmarked minefields exist in and around the border with Nicaragua.
safety.es: Hay campos minados sin señalizar en la frontera con Nicaragua y sus alrededores.
safety.quote: There are unmarked minefields in and around the border with Nicaragua.

health.en: Tap water is not generally safe to drink, but bottled water is cheap and widely available.
health.es: El agua del grifo generalmente no es segura para beber, pero el agua embotellada es barata y abundante.
health.quote: Tap water is not generally safe to drink, but bottled water is cheap and widely available.

health.en: Dial 911 and ask for an ambulance.
health.es: Llama al 911 y pide una ambulancia.
health.quote: Call 911 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: State-funded hospitals are underfunded and medicines are in short supply.
health.es: Los hospitales públicos tienen pocos fondos y hay escasez de medicinas.
health.quote: State-funded hospitals are underfunded and medicines are in short supply.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Honduras.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en algunas partes de Honduras.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Honduras.

health.en: Malaria occurs in rural areas, Roatán and other Bay Islands.
health.es: La malaria ocurre en zonas rurales, Roatán y otras Islas de la Bahía.
health.quote: Malaria occurs in rural areas, Roatán and other Bay Islands.

health.en: British-issued prescriptions cannot be used in Honduras.
health.es: Las recetas emitidas en el Reino Unido no se pueden usar en Honduras.
health.quote: You cannot use British-issued prescriptions in Honduras.

help.en: The emergency number for ambulance, fire and police is 911.
help.es: El número de emergencias para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 911.

getting_in.en: Major international airports are in San Pedro Sula, Tegucigalpa (Palmerola) and Roatan.
getting_in.es: Los principales aeropuertos internacionales están en San Pedro Sula, Tegucigalpa (Palmerola) y Roatán.
getting_in.quote: Major international airports with daily flights to Atlanta, Miami, Fort Lauderdale, Madrid, Mexico City, New York, San Salvador, and Houston are in San Pedro Sula, Tegucigalpa (Palmerola), and Roatan.

getting_in.en: Domestic airlines frequently cancel flights and are not obliged to issue refunds.
getting_in.es: Las aerolíneas nacionales cancelan vuelos con frecuencia y no están obligadas a reembolsar.
getting_in.quote: The interior domestic airlines frequently have flight cancellations, do not guarantee service, and are under no obligation to issue refunds if a flight does not occur.

getting_in.en: Buses serve Managua, San Salvador and Guatemala City, and arrive at San Pedro Sula's main bus terminal.
getting_in.es: Hay autobuses a Managua, San Salvador y Ciudad de Guatemala, y llegan a la terminal principal de San Pedro Sula.
getting_in.quote: Each of the capitals of the countries surrounding Honduras are also served by buses: Managua, San Salvador, Guatemala City.

getting_in.en: Entry by car is possible from Guatemala, El Salvador or Nicaragua.
getting_in.es: Es posible entrar en auto desde Guatemala, El Salvador o Nicaragua.
getting_in.quote: Possible from Guatemala, El Salvador, or Nicaragua.

getting_around.en: Small roads are often in poor condition and can be dangerous, and they deteriorate in the rainy season.
getting_around.es: Los caminos pequeños suelen estar en mal estado y pueden ser peligrosos, y empeoran en la temporada de lluvias.
getting_around.quote: Small roads are often in poor condition and can be dangerous to drive on. During the rainy season, the condition of roads deteriorates considerably.

getting_around.en: It is best to avoid driving at night.
getting_around.es: Lo mejor es evitar conducir de noche.
getting_around.quote: It is best to avoid driving at night.

getting_around.en: Regular ferries run from La Ceiba to Roatan and Utila.
getting_around.es: Hay servicio regular de transbordadores de La Ceiba a Roatán y Utila.
getting_around.quote: There is regular boat service from La Ceiba to the bay islands of Roatan and Utila.

getting_around.en: The ferry crossing to Roatan takes about 80 minutes each way.
getting_around.es: El transbordador a Roatán tarda unos 80 minutos por trayecto.
getting_around.quote: The crossing takes about 80 minutes each way.

getting_around.en: Hitchhiking should be a last resort for foreign visitors.
getting_around.es: El autostop debería ser el último recurso para los visitantes extranjeros.
getting_around.quote: it should only be used as a last resort if one is a visiting foreigner.

getting_around.en: Public buses are often poorly maintained, overcrowded and recklessly driven.
getting_around.es: Los autobuses públicos suelen estar mal mantenidos, abarrotados y conducidos con imprudencia.
getting_around.quote: Public buses are often poorly maintained, overcrowded and recklessly driven.

money.en: The currency is the lempira (HNL), but US dollars act as a second currency and nearly every business accepts both.
money.es: La moneda es el lempira (HNL), pero el dólar estadounidense actúa como segunda moneda y casi todos los negocios aceptan ambas.
money.quote: the U.S. dollar acts as a second currency and nearly every business accepts both.

money.en: It is wise to carry small bills under US$20.
money.es: Conviene llevar billetes pequeños de menos de 20 USD.
money.quote: It is wise to carry small bills (under US$20).

money.en: ATMs can be found in most cities, but the Bay Islands have few, so bring cash there.
money.es: Hay cajeros en la mayoría de las ciudades, pero las Islas de la Bahía tienen pocos, así que lleva efectivo.
money.quote: Be sure to bring cash to the Bay Islands because they do not have very many ATMs.

money.en: Lempiras can be hard to exchange outside Honduras, so exchange them all before leaving.
money.es: Los lempiras son difíciles de cambiar fuera de Honduras, así que cámbialos todos antes de salir.
money.quote: Lempiras can be hard to exchange outside of Honduras, so be prepared to exchange all Lempira before leaving the country.

money.en: It is difficult to exchange British pounds in Honduras, while US dollars are widely accepted.
money.es: Es difícil cambiar libras esterlinas en Honduras, mientras que los dólares estadounidenses se aceptan ampliamente.
money.quote: US dollars are widely accepted for exchange and payment. It is difficult to exchange British pounds in Honduras.

money.en: It is safer to withdraw money from ATMs in shopping centres and to change money in hotels or banks.
money.es: Es más seguro retirar dinero en cajeros de centros comerciales y cambiar dinero en hoteles o bancos.
money.quote: It is safer to withdraw money from ATMs in shopping centres and to change money in hotels or banks.

etiquette.en: Hondurans are described as friendly people who appreciate a respectful manner.
etiquette.es: Se describe a los hondureños como gente amable que aprecia un trato respetuoso.
etiquette.quote: Honduran citizens are friendly people who appreciate a respectful manner and are welcoming to tourists.

etiquette.en: It is important to demonstrate equal respect to both men and women.
etiquette.es: Es importante mostrar el mismo respeto a hombres y mujeres.
etiquette.quote: it is important to demonstrate equal respect to both men and women

connectivity.en: The country code for Honduras is +504.
connectivity.es: El código de país de Honduras es +504.
connectivity.quote: The country code for Honduras is +504.

connectivity.en: A local SIM card costs roughly L25 and offers prepaid plans by the hour, day or week.
connectivity.es: Una SIM local cuesta unos L25 y ofrece planes prepago por hora, día o semana.
connectivity.quote: you just need a local SIM card (roughly L25) and can start enjoying the prepaid access plans, which generally come in lots of an hour, a day, or a week
